title: 第23章 诡异势力第24章 完成任务敖绝神身世
slug: 签到大帝修为开局收下禁忌剑体
content_zh:
“大人救我！”
黑衣人首领突然发出一声惊叫，仿佛被一股神秘的力量控制。
随后，他如雕塑般僵立不动，整个人的气势却如火山爆发般剧变。
“啊！
啊！
啊！”
一声声凄厉的惨叫，仿佛是从地狱深处传来，让人毛骨悚然。
只见黑衣人首领地身体疯狂地扭曲着，颤抖着，犹如被狂风肆虐的残枝败叶。
额头上青筋暴起，如虬龙般狰狞，双目赤红，眼球凸出眼眶，仿佛要挣脱束缚。
敖绝神被这诡异的一幕吓得心惊胆战：“这人是怎么了？莫不是被恶鬼附身了吧？”
没过多久，只见此人原本剧烈扭动着的身躯逐渐停止了动作，慢慢地恢复了平静。
就在这时，他缓缓地再次睁开双眼，那对瞳孔仿佛隐藏于黑暗深渊之中，幽暗深邃得令人心悸不已。
乍一看去，竟如同厉鬼的眼眸一般，透露出丝丝寒意与邪恶，仿佛能够摄取人的灵魂，让人在不经意间便深陷其中无法自拔。
与此同时，从他的全身开始源源不断地散发出来一股极为诡异的气息。
这股气息犹如滚滚黑烟，缠绕在他身体四周，形成一层若有若无的黑色雾气。
而在这黑雾当中，隐约可以感受到疯狂的杀意、嗜血的渴望以及阴森死寂的氛围交织在一起。
如此种种负面情绪相互融合，使得整个人看上去就宛如一尊来自域外的可怕天魔降临世间。
更为可怕的是，“黑衣人首领”
的气势比之前磅礴了无数倍，实力竟然攀升到通天三重天。
“黑衣人首领”

首先看向四周，发现场上除了“他自己”
以及秦天阳二人其余人等全灭。
不禁眉头一皱，随后开口：“一群废物，还得本护法亲自出马！”
声音极为沙哑，仿佛来自地狱的恶鬼。
随后他又看向一旁的敖绝神以及秦天阳。
敖绝神才区区元神一重天的修为，并且根据门主赐下的法宝显示，此人正是他们组织的目标。
至于秦天阳好似一个普通人，没有任何气息。
但是一个普通人可以立在虚空中吗？
因此，他断定是秦天阳阻止了他们的行动，还杀了他的属下。
“阁下是人族，而此人是妖族。
此事应该与阁下并无关系吧？”
“黑衣人首领”
气势爆发，无尽威压充斥着天地间，道：“若是阁下愿意就此退去，不再插手。
本座感激不尽！”
他看不透此人的实力，虽然此时的他只是由一缕分魂控制的属下，但是实力也有通天境三重天的实力，完全不惧此人，只是他不愿意多事而已。
“那就不好意思了，这位妖族少年资质不错，被我看上了，我想收他为弟子。”
听完之后，秦天阳似乎不为所动，神色平静面无表情，淡淡道。
“敬酒不吃吃罚酒，既然找死，那就怪不得别人了！”
“黑衣人首领”
冷哼道，随后一掌拍出，引动风云变色。

轰隆隆！
天地间灵气汇聚而成一张巨大的手掌，虽然仅数十丈大小，可其威势比原来的黑衣人首领可怕了无数倍。
content_en:
"Sir, save me!"
The leader of the men in black suddenly let out a scream, as if controlled by a mysterious force.
Afterwards, he stood as still as a sculpture, but his whole aura changed drastically like a volcano erupting.
"Ah!
Ah!
Ah! "
The shrill screams seemed to come from the depths of hell, making people's hair stand on end.
The body of the leader of the man in black was twisted and trembling crazily, like a broken branch and leaf that had been ravaged by the strong wind.
The veins on his forehead popped out, as ferocious as a horned dragon, his eyes were red, and the eyeballs protruded from their sockets, as if they were trying to break free.
Ao Jueshen was frightened by this strange scene: "What's wrong with this man? Is he possessed by an evil spirit?"
Not long after, I saw that the man's violently twisting body gradually stopped moving and slowly returned to calm.
At this moment, he slowly opened his eyes again. Those pupils seemed to be hidden in the dark abyss, and the darkness was so deep that it made people feel heart-stopping.
At first glance, it looks like the eyes of a ghost, revealing a hint of coldness and evil, as if it can absorb people's souls, making people inadvertently trapped in it and unable to extricate themselves.
At the same time, an extremely strange aura began to emit from his whole body.
This breath was like billowing black smoke, wrapping around his body, forming a layer of vague black mist.
And in this black mist, one can vaguely feel the crazy killing intent, bloodthirsty desire and the eerie and dead atmosphere intertwined together.
Such a fusion of negative emotions makes the whole person look like a terrifying demon from outside the world has descended into the world.
What’s even more terrifying is that the “leader of the men in black”
His aura was countless times more majestic than before, and his strength actually climbed to the third level of the sky.
"The leader of the men in black"
First, he looked around and found that there was only "himself" on the field.
As well as Qin Tianyang and the rest, they were all destroyed.
He couldn't help but frown, and then said: "A bunch of trash, I have to personally take action!"
The voice was extremely hoarse, like an evil ghost from hell.
Then he looked at Ao Jueshen and Qin Tianyang on the side.
Ao Jueshen only has the cultivation level of the first level of Yuan Shen, and according to the magic weapon given by the sect master, this person is the target of their organization.
As for Qin Tianyang, he seemed like an ordinary person without any breath.
But can an ordinary person stand in the void?
Therefore, he concluded that Qin Tianyang stopped their action and killed his subordinates.
"Your Excellency is from the human race, and this person is from the demon race.
This matter should have nothing to do with you, right? "
"The leader of the men in black"
The momentum exploded, and endless coercion filled the world, and he said: "If you are willing to just retreat and stop interfering.
I am very grateful! "
He couldn't see through this person's strength. Although he was just a subordinate controlled by a split soul at this time, his strength was as strong as the third level of Tongtian Realm. He was not afraid of this person at all, but he didn't want to get into trouble.
"I'm sorry then. This demon boy has good qualifications and I'm interested in him. I want to accept him as my disciple."
After listening, Qin Tianyang seemed unmoved, with a calm expression and said calmly.
"If you don't eat the toast, you'll be fined with wine. If you're seeking death, then you can't blame others!"
"The leader of the men in black"
He snorted coldly, and then clapped his palm, causing the situation to change color.
Boom!
The spiritual energy between heaven and earth gathered to form a huge palm. Although it was only a few dozen feet in size, its power was countless times more terrifying than the original leader of the men in black.
